chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Nawfali, from Isa ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
From the oaths of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was: 'No, and I seek forgiveness of Allah.'
ai.seo_question: What was a common oath used by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the specific customary oaths of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny), which were 'La' (No) and 'Astaghfirullah' (I seek forgiveness from Allah). In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often cited to illustrate the Prophet's unique linguistic habits and the authenticity of his speech, distinguishing his personal expressions from the divine revelation of the Quran.
